A failed furnace, a broken air conditioner, and a clogged drain have one thing in common: none of them wait for a convenient time. EZ Flow was built to answer that call directly. We have licensed technicians who handle heating, air conditioning, and plumbing under one company.

Equipment and Strategy Behind Every Job

Reliable repairs depend on the right diagnostic tools. Our crew carries combustion analyzers to check furnace and boiler efficiency, manifold gauge sets, and digital leak detectors for refrigerant work. We bring sewer cameras to inspect drain and sewer lines before recommending a system repair or replacement.

This matters because it changes the advice you get. A camera inspection can show that a sewer line needs a targeted repair instead of a full replacement, and a combustion analyzer reading can confirm a furnace is running safely rather than relying on a visual check alone.

We also carry parts and equipment from major manufacturers, including York, Ruud, Rheem, Lennox, Carrier, Goodman, American Standard, A.O. Smith, and Haier, so most existing systems in the area can be serviced without a lengthy special order.

Warning Signs Worth Calling About
Most heating, cooling, and plumbing failures give some warning before they become emergencies. Catching these early usually costs less than waiting for a full breakdown.
If any of these sound familiar, it is worth a call before the system fails outright, especially before a peak season like a cold snap or a summer heat wave.
Heating:
Short cycling, a yellow or flickering pilot light, banging or rattling from the furnace, or rooms that heat unevenly.
Air Conditioning:
Warm air from the vents, ice forming on the unit, a sudden spike in your electric bill, or a musty smell when the system runs.
Plumbing:
Slow drains in more than one fixture, gurgling sounds from pipes, a water heater that runs out of hot water quickly, or damp spots near the basement floor.
